# Municipal Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2000

**Additional Appropriations from the 2000 Local Government Service Equalization Fund**

## Summary

This ordinance approves additional appropriations from the [[2000]] Local Government Service Equalization Fund amounting to P346,106.00. The funds are intended for additional primary needs and other expenses of the devolved offices of the local government of [[Pitogo, Quezon]]. The ordinance was enacted during a regular session of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of [[Pitogo, Quezon]].

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Appropriates P346,106.00 from the [[2000]] Local Government Service Equalization Fund for additional primary needs and expenses of the devolved offices of the local government of [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
2.  **Section 2.** Incorporates the Additional Appropriation No. 01, Series of [[2000]], prepared by the Honorable [[Punong Bayan]], as an additional part of the ordinance, marked as "Annex A".
3.  **Section 3.** Stipulates that the ordinance shall take effect upon its approval.
4.  **Section 4.** Approved on May 3, [[2000]] in [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
